title: Towards Easier-to-Tune Training Algorithms: New Results from AlgoPerf
abstract: arXiv:2610.13036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating deep learning optimizer is challenging because confounding factors such as hyperparameter tuning and optimizer-model co-design often obscure true algorithmic performance. We present results of the updated AlgoPerf V1 benchmark, in which we evaluate a new set of training algorithms on wall-clock time-to-target across nine workloads on fixed hardware. This report focuses on the results of the benchmark's self-tuning ruleset, which requires submissions to use a single configuration across all workloads. Out of the 13 submissions in PyTorch and JAX, Schedule-Free AdamW ranked first. In addition to the wall-clock scores, we also analyze the trade-offs between step efficiency and wall-clock execution, revealing that matrix-preconditioned and two-loop methods achieve good sample efficiency but require more aggressive computational optimizations to be competitive in runtime. translated_title: 迈向更易调优的训练算法：来自AlgoPerf的新结果
translated_abstract: 评估深度学习优化器是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为超参数调优和优化器-模型协同设计等混杂因素往往会掩盖算法的真实性能。我们展示了更新后的AlgoPerf V1基准测试的结果，在固定硬件上对一组新的训练算法在九个工作负载上的到达目标所需的实际运行时间进行了评估。本报告重点关注该基准测试自调优规则集的结果，该规则要求提交的算法在所有工作负载上使用单一配置。在基于PyTorch和JAX的13个提交算法中，Schedule-Free AdamW排名第一。除了实际运行时间得分外，我们还分析了步数效率与实际运行时间之间的权衡，发现矩阵预条件和双循环方法具有良好的样本效率，但需要更激进的计算优化才能在运行时间上具备竞争力。最后，我们的超参数显著性和保留分析
tldr: 在更新版AlgoPerf V1基准测试的自调优规则下，Schedule-Free AdamW在13个提交算法中排名第一，同时分析表明矩阵预条件和双循环方法虽样本效率优异，但需更激进的计算优化才能在实际运行时间上具竞争力。
en_tdlr: In the updated AlgoPerf V1 benchmark's self-tuning ruleset, Schedule-Free AdamW ranked first among 13 submissions, while analyses reveal that matrix-preconditioned and two-loop methods achieve good sample efficiency but require more aggressive computational optimizations to be competitive in wall-clock time.
